name: Kama Cookware
description: Kama Cookware — a WooCommerce-ready block theme for a cookware shop with a repair and seasoning workshop. A pale cool-grey stage on which five product photographs climb a rising diagonal, a vertical caption rail and a slim info bar; a sticky half-width picture that opens through a mask as each hob scene passes; offset product cards; a single dark gallery band whose frames zoom in; fixed service prices; a parallax shop interior; and a giant wordmark marquee with photo pills. Fraunces for headings, Source Sans 3 for reading. Sample content in English. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.

store.withoutPlugin: Shop, product and service pages stay ordinary pages with photographs and prices. Cart and checkout are not used; orders are taken at the Harbour Street workshop.

fonts.role: display: headings, the wordmark, product names, prices of service (Regular 400, variable, Latin subset)
